doc.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Never wanting to be a star
summary: She says she never wished to be a movie star and only dreamed of a man who would save her.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Were you aware -- did you have an awareness then of how -- what these images were about and what they were trying to do?

No. It was my first time. How would I have known? I hadn't wished to be a star. I can honestly say that. I always dreamed of a man. I didn't dream of children, but I was going to meet this god who was going to save me from myself. I didn't dream of being a star or being a movie star or any kind of other star. I still don't care anything about it. But I think it just was my lot because I've had plenty of chances to be a super star. They can give it to their mother. I don't want everybody to know my name.
